topics.description: Medicaid fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with several cases of fraud being investigated and prosecuted. The St. Cloud Autism Center Owner recently pleaded guilty to a $6 million Medicaid fraud scheme.
topics.reason: Recent guilty plea in Medicaid fraud case

topics.description: Allegations of abuse by immigration enforcement officers are being investigated in Minnesota. The state has launched an online portal to probe these allegations.
topics.reason: New investigation into immigration enforcement abuse allegations
